source.label: Skillz Sport Performance visual system
source.provenance: Binding Sport application branding layer confirmed from the 2026-08-26 Sport Athlete Management / Masters Diagnostics design templates. Existing accepted Impeccable layout and non-color CSS remain authoritative; this profile supplies colors and product-specific brand assets only.

layer_model.impeccable_ui_template: Owns the accepted layout, non-color CSS, typography, spacing, component geometry, navigation, responsive behavior and information hierarchy. It is frozen by default during branding work.
layer_model.sport_performance_branding: Owns the confirmed color spectrum and product-specific logo/favicon/app-icon assets. It must not replace accepted Impeccable CSS/layout.

shared_rules: Use the confirmed Sport Performance spectrum, geometric discipline, stroke language and typographic family across Sport products.
Logo, favicon and app icon must derive from one product-specific mark.
Related Sport products share family resemblance but must remain distinguishable at favicon size.
Product differentiation comes from the central symbol and hierarchy, not from unrelated color systems.
Applying Sport Performance branding to an existing accepted Sport application must preserve its Impeccable layout and all non-color CSS behavior.
brand_family.product_mark_rule: The mark must graphically reflect at least two of the project's two to three most important properties or value propositions.

rules: Use labels, markers, line styles or shapes in addition to color.
teal_bright is a chart/accent color and is not an approved normal-text filled background.
Reserve critical red for risk/injury/stop states; do not use it as decorative emphasis.
Use recovery violet for recovery/readiness or a clearly documented secondary analytic dimension.
